claims.paraphrase: OCC generally routes mutual funds through equity-investment measurement and earnings, including fair-value changes before sale.
claims.exclusions: Use a new unit-price register and partial sale. Exclude fund distributions, transaction costs, equity-method/consolidation analysis, tax and source examples.

claims.paraphrase: OCC scopes out unconditionally cancellable commitments; covered expected losses incorporate expected funding and are recorded in a liability with an earnings charge.
claims.exclusions: Use a fictional portfolio with stipulated scope and cancellation conclusions. Exclude guarantees, letters of credit, derivatives, insurance, fair-value-option contracts, HELOC legal analysis, loan funding and source scenarios.

claims.paraphrase: OCC measures the stipulated bank-beneficiary policy asset by its realizable cash surrender value; the period change offsets premiums in calculating income or expense.
claims.exclusions: Use a multi-policy reconciliation and independent cash-value sensitivities. Exclude split-dollar arrangements, employee benefits, death claims, policy sales, taxes, source fact-pattern details and source numerical examples.

claims.paraphrase: OCC expenses startup and organization activities as incurred while separating fixed-asset acquisition/readiness costs; startup use of an asset does not itself defer depreciation.
claims.exclusions: Use an invented launch cost register, supplied equipment conclusions, depreciation and double-entry reconciliation. Exclude debt/equity issuance, acquisitions, software, leases, entity reimbursements, taxes and source lists/examples.
